description: Check one crypto wallet address: which chain it belongs to (EVM, TRON, Bitcoin, Solana — from the format alone), whether its checksum is valid (EIP-55, Base58Check, bech32/bech32m), whether it is on the US Treasury OFAC SDN sanctions list (read daily) or among the addresses the FBI published in an alert (the Binance theft of October 2026, 628 addresses), and how many pages DechoNet's phishing check judged dangerous showed it. Listed means on that day's list, not a finding about the owner; not listed is not a statement that the address is clean (most scam addresses are on no list). Balances, transaction history and the owner are not looked at — see 'Not checked'. The address is not stored. Use crypto_check_before_sign to judge an address together with the page that asked and the wallet request. Read-only; no API key; rate-limited.

address.description: Wallet address (0x…, T…, bc1…/1…/3…, or a Solana address)

name: wallet_address_check

actions.description: Recommended next actions, most important first

grade.description: Letter grade (A+ to F) when the tool grades the target

observation.description: How much was actually observed and when. A partial observation means some checks did not answer: missing parts are not verified, never clean.

receipts.description: Signed observation receipts behind this result, one per lookup: when, from where and under which rules version DechoNet observed it. Each url shows the record and checks its Ed25519 signature.

reportUrl.description: Human-facing interactive report for this exact lookup on dechonet.com

score.description: 0-100 score when the tool scores the target
